name: SOC Darktrace NDR
description: Enhancements for Darktrace Darktrace telemetry used by the SOC Framework on Cortex XSIAM. Reshapes events from `darktrace_darktrace_raw` into properly-shaped XSIAM alerts with DS:Darktrace/Darktrace tags so Foundation Product Classification routes them into the Network category.
author: Palo Alto Networks
